jobs.title: Retail Sales Assistant - Part Time
jobs.description:
Job Description

Description

What’s the opportunity?

As part of the Retail team, you’ll be based within our store in Junction 27 Retail Park in Leeds welcoming customers in and talking to them about our gorgeous furniture and carpets.

What does the role involve?

Welcome customers into the store and support them in finding the perfect piece of furniture or flooring for their home
Accurately complete customer orders and process finance applications
Accountable for delivering personal sales and KPIs
Work within the team to deliver a 5 star customer experience
Make sure the showrooms look their best through general housekeeping, cleaning and moving furniture when it’s needed
Help to make sure our showrooms are warm, friendly, safe environments for everyone within them
Continuously develop and maintain knowledge on all ScS products and services
Undertake, as required, other duties in keeping with the general nature of the role

What’s in it for you?

Hourly rate of £9.74 - £10.73 with a realistic OTE of £30K pro rata per year
In this store, our Retail Sales Assistants earn on average £800 - £1200 pro rata per month on top of their basic salary although there’s no limit on how much you can earn
Guaranteed commission of £400 pro rata per month in your first three months
Competitions and incentives – recent holiday incentives include a Virgin Cruise around Miami and the Bahamas and trips to New York, Dubai and Italy
Sodexo benefits platform - access to 100s of high street discounts and more – holiday discounts, gym discounts, cinema discounts, evouchers, cashback and more!
Generous holiday allowance
Medicash – low cost health plans
Virtual GP – Access to a GP service 24/7

jobs.title: Barista Part time
jobs.description:
Job Description

Barista Must be available Friday/Saturday/Sunday and all of summer

At Costa Coffee, we craft great coffee and memorable experiences. As a Barista, you’ll bring energy, warmth and skill to every shift. We also offer flexible shifts to suit both your needs and the store’s.

Why Costa

  • £13.12
  • 50% discount on all food and drink in Costa-owned stores
  • Matched pension up to 10%
  • Coca-Cola share scheme
  • Financial Support Fund
  • More perks at: https://costaperks

We’re committed to diversity, equity and inclusion, and our values, Discipline to Deliver, Passion for Progress, Win with Warmth, Courage to Challenge and Trusted Team Player, shape how we work. Through the Costa Foundation, you’ll also support communities locally and globally.

What you’ll do

  • Serve great coffee and deliver an energising customer experience
  • Master our menu and maintain high standards
  • Keep the store clean, welcoming and running smoothly
  • Work collaboratively as a team player to make the store the best it can be

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with:

  • Resourcefulness, adaptability, and a positive, can-do attitude
  • Accountability and pride in delivering quality
  • A calm, composed approach and great communication skills
  • A genuine people focus and enthusiasm for working with others

Apply through a quick Sapia.ai chat. –

When you apply, you’ll start with a quick, casual chat via Sapia.ai, just a few simple questions you can answer anytime, anywhere. This AI-powered tool helps us assess key traits and skills fairly by comparing your responses to the role’s requirements . Don’t worry there will always be human involvement in the review of your responses and in making the final hiring decision.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Part-time, Contract or Full-time. Remote or Hybrid
jobs.description:
Job Description

Sales Development Representative - Part-time, Contract or Full-time. Remote or Hybrid


At FISCAL Technologies, we're not just selling software – we're partnering with finance leaders to protect over £350 billion global spend every year through innovative AI-driven solutions that deliver ROI within three months.


We need passionate relationship builders who can open doors, book meetings and help develop sales opportunities.


As a Sales Development Representative focusing on booking new business meetings, you'll work directly with our new business sales team and marketing teams.


  • Prospecting and lead generation: Identify and research potential customers who are a good fit for the company's products or services.
  • Outbound outreach: Initiate contact with potential leads through various channels including phone calls, emails, and social media platforms.
  • Lead qualification: Qualify leads based on predefined criteria to ensure they have the interest, budget, and need for the company's offerings.
  • Booking meetings: Schedule and book qualified meetings or product demonstrations for Account Executives.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with sales and marketing teams to align on strategies and messaging.


Required skills and qualifications

  • Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and listening skills are crucial for building rapport and making a strong first impression.
  • Organisation and time management: Must be able to manage a high volume of tasks, organize leads, and prioritize daily activities efficiently.
  • Tech-savviness: Proficiency with CRM systems and other sales tools is essential for success.
  • Persistence and motivation: Ability to work in a target-driven environment and stay motivated through consistent outreach efforts.


Why Join FISCAL?

  • Competitive salary and flexibility
  • Be part of an exciting growth company protecting organisations around the world.
  • Make a Difference: Our solutions deliver meaningful impact for finance teams worldwide
  • Growth Opportunity: Join a growing company with ambitious plans where your contributions matter


FISCAL Technologies is proud to be a previous recipient of the Queen's Award for Innovation and recognised as a great place to work. We're committed to building a diverse team that reflects the clients we serve.
